brandComInfo.introduce:
Kulicke & Soffa（纳斯达克股票代码：KLIC）是一家美商独资企业，是全球半导体封装领域的领先者。库力索法公司始建于1951年，多年来一直与全球重要的半导体制造商携手合作，并为业界多项具重要意义的技术突破做出了关键性贡献。库力索法公司致力于为全球汽车、消费电子、通讯、计算机和工业等领域提供领先的半导体封装和电子装配解决方案。

        库力索法半导体(苏州)有限公司2002年成立于苏州工业园区，现有员工近1500人，自有办公场所13,500平方米，拥有并肩欧美的先进研发体系和实验环境，立足大中华区，结合其丰富的业界专业知识，强大的工艺技术和研发力量，致力于迎接下一代电子元件封装的挑战、助力中国制造2025。

         “以人为本”是库力索法的核心价值之一，公司视员工为首要资产，为员工提供发展和成长的机会及平台，与员工共同“学习、成长、超越”。公司拥有完善的福利制度、人性化的工作氛围，友好合作的工作伙伴，完善的员工学习和发展机制。

        库力索法大家庭欢迎您的加入！

jobInfo.address: 苏州吴中区库力索法半导体(苏州)有限公司一层
jobInfo.jobName: 自动化测试开发工程师
jobInfo.postDescription:
Main Responsibilities:
1.           Cooperate with project manager and supervisor to complete software requirement research and requirement analysis
2.           Participate in the construction of test framework, the definition of test cases, and development of auto test cases
3.           Participate in project application software requirement analysis, software architecture design, detailed design code implementation, system integration and software technical documentation
4.          Maintain the software and existing functionalities, troubleshooting and fix issues reported by customers
5.           Participate in the scheme design and use case writing of system integration test and unit test, and timely modify the problems encountered in the test

Experience and Skills Required:
1.           5+ years of work experience, computer, electronics, automation, and related BS degree or above
2.           Deep understanding of test theory and test framework
3.           Deep understanding of Web programming and Web application architecture, both front-end and back-end, Node.js / JavaScript or Python, experience in building high-performance, scalable online services is a plus
4.           Excellent technical design, problem solving skills and ability to quickly adapt to different team roles such as development, testing and customer support
5.           Good team player and good communications skills. Great communication skills and fluency in English as a working language。
